reasons: Missing-clause claim is substantiated: the cited paragraphs (§14.12 Risk of Loss) show no insurance obligation, and the vendor is a hosting provider that holds Base Component risk and processes personal information, squarely within the rule's trigger.

Inserted language reaches the preferred position in full — CGL USD 1M/2M, E&O USD 2M, cyber USD 5M tied to Customer Data/personal information, statutory workers' compensation, and certificates on request — with the one-year tail from the model language.
Edit is minimal and correctly directed: existing §14.12 text is untouched, the new paragraph binds IBM only, and it is placed in the general/miscellaneous section as the redline guidance directs.
Comment is accurate, concise, in the required voice with the [Playbook] prefix, states what changed and why, and offers the sanctioned fallback (E&O USD 1M / cyber USD 2M).
Deterministic checks all pass; the only nit is that the inserted heading is unnumbered in the render while the rationale calls it §14.12A, which does not affect substance.
